I apologise for the delay in submitting the code. I was on my way home. Please find the code below

###Mesh using Parish
Prdomain <- inla.nonconvex.hull(as.matrix(Parish@data[, 5:6]), convex=2000, resolution=c(300,300))
mesh <- inla.mesh.2d(boundary=Prdomain, max.edge=c(10000,25000), cutoff=3000)

loc <- cbind(df$x, df$y)

A <- inla.spde.make.A(mesh, loc)
spde <- inla.spde2.pcmatern(mesh=mesh, prior.range=c(0.05, 0.01), prior.sigma=c(1,0.01))

form0 = inla.surv(FU_months, Event)~0 + a0 + NDV1   + NDV2   + NDV3 + NDV4
form = update(form0, .~. + f(spatial, model=spde))

 stk = inla.stack(data=list(time=df$FU_months, cens=df$Event),
                         (A=list(A,1), effect=list(list(spatial = 1:spde$n.spde), dataframe(a0=1, df[, c(7:13)]))) 
 
model1 <- inla(form, family=family="weibull", data=inla.stack.data(stk), control.predictor=list(A=inla.stack.A(stk), compute=T))

NB: Unfortunately, I cannot include the data because it is a sensitive data and I can only access remotely via a secured server. My data frame has ~9.89 million observations, 

Thank you.
